The '''Housing Squad''' was a division of [[the Young]] led by [[Nena]], responsible for helping the citizens of [[Zehava]] displaced during the conflicts of the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]] and the [[Battle of Zehava (Young–Elders War)|Battle of Zehava]].
